title: Fusion in the Blood
style: Modern jazz fusion at 108 BPM with a fat, driving modern bass line (funky and prominent). Electric energy with jazz harmony and chord changes underneath. Female vocalist Jazz with soulful, bluesy delivery mixed with energetic and developed scat. Strong funky groove meets sophisticated jazz improvisation. Powerful, groovy, and musical production with electric textures and improvisational freedom in the middle section.
lyrics:
Full Lyrics
[Intro – Groovy bass + Jazz scat over it]
Yeah… bring that bass in…
Bee boo bop… fusion…
Scat scat cat… electric…
[Verse 1 – Jazz]
They said keep it pure, keep it straight and clean
But the world got louder and the music got mean
So we plugged it in, let the bass start to talk
Now the jazz is moving, and it’s starting to walk
[Pre-Chorus]
Different worlds colliding, different rhythms blending
That’s where the real magic starts happening
[Chorus – Jazz]
This is fusion…
Jazz with the fire turned up
Funk in the bass, soul in the cut
It’s still jazz to me, just turned up loud
Fusion in the blood, fusion in the crowd
Bee boo bop… fusion…
Scat scat cat… fusion…
[Verse 2 – Jazz]
Some call it betrayal, some call it the new
But when the groove hits right, what you gonna do?
Miles showed the way, then the others came through
Now the sound keeps evolving, and the feeling is true
[Chorus]
This is fusion…
Jazz with the fire turned up
Modern bass thumping while the changes stay tough
It’s still jazz to me when the energy’s high
Fusion in the spirit, reaching for the sky
[Scat / Fusion Break – Jazz (energetic & developed)]
Doo-bee-doo… wah-wah… bop-bee…
Scat-scat… fusion… electric…
Biddle-dat-doo… re-bop… higher now…
Bee-boo-bop… fusion… let it drop…
(Builds with rhythmic intensity and melodic development)
[Bridge – Jazz]
You can call it what you want, give it any name
But when the music hits you, you feel the same
Jazz at the root, everything else is just fuel
Fusion keeps it moving, keeps the whole thing cool
[Final Chorus – Big and groovy]
This is fusion…
Jazz with the fire turned up
Funk in the pocket, soul in the cut
It’s still jazz to me when the bass starts to speak
Fusion in the music… fusion in the week
[Outro – Fading groovy bass + scat]
Bee boo bop… fusion…
Scat scat cat…
It’s still jazz…
It’s still fusion to me…
